decision.reason: The upgrade guide's Changed Metrics section contradicts itself about the new name. [ev-7ede52ce8bb8] says `doublewrite_identity_crd_total_count` was renamed to `doublewrite_crd_identities`, but [ev-eaf366d94d17] says the same metric was renamed to `doublewrite_identity_crd_total`. The sibling entries repeat the same split ([ev-d6005e84dee9] vs [ev-2349d1c09109], [ev-6a341603b700] vs [ev-df8818f69d5e]), so the rename's after value and replacedBy can't be settled. There's also a subject problem: this is a Prometheus metric name, and no subject family fits it well; protocol-behavior is a stretch. Deciding this needs the 1.17.0 metrics reference or the source code that registers the metric.
